desc: Ideation: signed-graph / per-bit decomposition approach with pitfalls (self-loops, parallel edges, recursion depth, isolated vertices, bits above max Z).
Implement full solution: build adjacency, iterative BFS/DFS assigning relative XOR p[v], validate every edge, print -1 on contradiction.
Per component per bit, count ones in p values and choose root bit minimizing count; assemble A_i = p[i] XOR root.
Verify against all three sample inputs (0 3 4 / -1 / 0 2 9 6 0) and confirm iterative O(N+M+31N) performance within limits.
